notes.title: Dice Assassin is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

"Dice Assassin" is now available! This unique turn-based strategy game combines dice, cards, and board elements to bring you a fresh gaming experience like never before. Have fun playing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2573470/_/

notes.title: Dice Assassin Demo Release and Participation in the Steam Deckbuilders Fest!
notes.content:
Greetings, Master Assassins!

We are thrilled to announce the release of the Dice Assassin demo! 

This is a unique turn-based strategy game that combines dice, cards, and board elements, offering an unprecedented fresh gaming experience. You can now download and delve into this challenging and enjoyable game world for free!

But that's not all! We are honored to announce that Dice Assassin will be participating in Steam Deckbuilders Fest. We wish you a lot of fun playing!
